role: ONE row per capability. The single answer to 'what can this thing do, and what is that claim worth'. Supersedes reading §§229-262 to reconstruct it.

statuses.ACCEPTED: proven and usable as it stands
statuses.ACCEPTED_WITH_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION: proven, and its operational conclusion is not authoritative until a person settles it
statuses.BLOCKED: cannot proceed without a decision or a missing capability
statuses.UNVERIFIED_LIVE: not contradicted, and never exercised against a live environment

capabilities.capability: Downstream finding reconciliation from an Expert result
capabilities.evidence: §261 and §262 both refuse creation deliberately; §265 cases L, M, N prove the guard
capabilities.productConsequence: No finding is CREATED from an Expert analysis, settled or not. §265 did not change that: what it added is a GUARD — a finding whose review cites a server-authored Expert analysis cannot be finalized unless that analysis carries a settled operational conclusion. Reconciliation and guarding are different acts and only the second is built.
capabilities.boundary: must not be enabled before the authority guards exist
capabilities.nextAction: a product decision about whether an Expert result should create a finding at all

capabilities.nextAction: a server-side governed-evidence loader bound to the inspection's release binding

capabilities.capability: Downstream authority guard on finding finalization
capabilities.evidence: verification/expert-hazlenz-265-frontend-product-workflow-2026-09-12/SECTION-265-ACCEPTANCE.json cases L, M, N
capabilities.productConsequence: a finding cannot be finalized from an Expert analysis whose operational conclusion no person has settled; once settled, the SAME review finalizes, and an override is consumed as the human value rather than the Expert proposal
capabilities.boundary: ONE consumer. The deterministic path is untouched — a review citing no analysis, or a client_supplied one, is unaffected. Completion readiness, report finalization, notifications and the executive summary are not yet guarded.

capabilities.capability: Server-side read of the current Expert analysis
capabilities.evidence: verification/expert-hazlenz-265-frontend-product-workflow-2026-09-12/ P0 and cases A-J
capabilities.productConsequence: an interface can recover the whole authority picture after a reload without re-executing, so a page refresh costs nothing and cannot be served from a stale client copy
capabilities.boundary: same guard profile as the two writes; writes nothing; never returns the raw provider payload

capabilities.capability: Reviewer revision of a settled Expert analysis
capabilities.evidence: not built; §265 was instructed to carry it as a deferred product decision
capabilities.productConsequence: an ANALYSIS_CONFIRMED or ANALYSIS_OVERRIDDEN analysis cannot be re-opened. The beta workflow is one settlement per analysis.
capabilities.boundary: this is a deliberate beta scope decision, NOT a statement that the decision is permanently irreversible
capabilities.nextAction: a product-owner decision, including what re-opening means for a downstream finding already finalized on the settled conclusion

betaReadinessDomains.note: A BLOCKER domain does not mean the domain is architecturally wrong. Every one of the ten maps to a finite item in BETA-BLOCKERS.json, and none requires redesign.
